name: @btkulka/gemini-client
description: The Gemini API (Google AI Studio) for Ben's apps: an API key in, then models.list and Veo video generation (start the long-running predict, get the operation, wait for it with backoff and an AbortSignal, download the finished MP4 as bytes), with a per-second price table and a cost estimate. Built on http-kit (timeouts, Retry-After on 429, backoff on 5xx and network errors, typed GeminiError with Google's status, reason and a category). Browser-safe: no node:* imports, no Buffer. A Node-only CLI, gemini-video, renders a prompt or a JSON file of jobs to <name>.mp4 files, the key from Benhäus Credentials.

hints.message: Google doesn't know this key. Copy it again from aistudio.google.com/apikey (it starts with AIza).
The key's Google Cloud project doesn't have the Generative Language API turned on. Enable it for that project (the link is in the error), or make a key in AI Studio, which turns it on for you.
The key is restricted to other APIs. In Google Cloud › Credentials, allow the Generative Language API on it, or make a fresh key in AI Studio.
The key is restricted to websites. Make an unrestricted key (or one restricted by API) for Benhäus and the CLI.
Google won't serve this key from here: either the Gemini API isn't offered in your country at all, or only its paid tier is (then set up billing for the key's project in AI Studio).
